components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single warm, verb-led action in a section or dialog.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 44px; padding: 11px 17px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: oklch(53% 0.14 38); color: oklch(98.5% 0.015 82); font: 760 14px/1 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 6px 16px oklch(53% 0.14 38 / .28); transition: background 160ms ease, transform 160ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: oklch(48% 0.15 35); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(.97); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid oklch(65% 0.12 40); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A quiet bordered alternative that never competes with the main action.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 44px; padding: 11px 17px; border: 1px solid oklch(84% 0.035 74); border-radius: 999px; background: oklch(98.5% 0.015 82); color: oklch(30% 0.045 18); font: 760 14px/1 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background 160ms ease, border-color 160ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: oklch(62% 0.075 137); background: oklch(91% 0.05 130); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid oklch(65% 0.12 40); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: A warm paper field with a precise semantic focus ring.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; color: oklch(30% 0.045 18); font: 740 12px/1.4 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field input { box-sizing: border-box; width: 100%; min-height: 46px; padding: 11px 12px; border: 1px solid oklch(84% 0.035 74); border-radius: 11px; outline: 0; background: oklch(98.5% 0.015 82); color: oklch(30% 0.045 18); font: 16px/1.4 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field input:focus { border-color: oklch(62% 0.14 38); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(91% 0.055 47); }

components.name: Bottom Navigation
components.description: Four labeled destinations with a soft, unmistakable current state.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); gap: 4px; padding: 7px; border: 1px solid oklch(84% 0.035 74); border-radius: 14px; background: oklch(98.5% 0.015 82); box-shadow: 0 8px 24px oklch(32% 0.035 40 / .09); } .ds-nav button { min-height: 48px; border: 0; border-radius: 12px; background: transparent; color: oklch(48% 0.025 55); font: 760 11px/1 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-nav button:hover { color: oklch(30% 0.045 18); } .ds-nav button.is-active { background: oklch(91% 0.055 47); color: oklch(43% 0.13 35); } .ds-nav button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid oklch(65% 0.12 40); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Habit Row
components.description: The signature open habit row with a botanical mark, tiny version, rhythm, and completion circle.
components.html: Drink waterOne glass is enough
components.css: .ds-ritual { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 48px 1fr 48px; align-items: center; gap: 12px; min-height: 104px; padding: 12px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid oklch(89% 0.026 76); color: oklch(30% 0.045 18); font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-ritual-icon { display: grid; width: 46px; height: 46px; place-items: center; border-radius: 42% 58% 55% 45%; background: oklch(91% 0.05 130); color: oklch(48% 0.09 138); } .ds-ritual-icon svg { width: 25px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.8; } .ds-ritual div { display: grid; gap: 4px; } .ds-ritual strong { font-size: 14px; } .ds-ritual small { color: oklch(46% 0.035 35); } .ds-rhythm { display: flex; gap: 5px; } .ds-rhythm i { width: 10px; height: 10px; border: 1px solid oklch(84% 0.035 74); border-radius: 50%; } .ds-rhythm i.is-cared { border-color: oklch(48% 0.09 138); background: oklch(48% 0.09 138); } .ds-ritual button { display: grid; width: 48px; height: 48px; place-items: center; border: 2px solid oklch(62% 0.075 137); border-radius: 50%; background: oklch(48% 0.09 138); color: oklch(98.5% 0.015 82); } .ds-ritual button svg { width: 24px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 2; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-ritual button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid oklch(72% 0.12 40); outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview: The interface should feel like opening a quiet illustrated journal beside a sunny window. Painterly scenes carry emotion, editorial plum typography gives the experience dignity, and crisp interface controls preserve speed and trust. The daily loop stays sparse, while Moonlit Nook changes the light without changing the product identity.
keyCharacteristics: Painterly atmosphere paired with precise, accessible controls.
Editorial serif headings and quiet humanist interface type.
Warm paper, persimmon action, sage completion, and plum ink.
Open rows and dividers before nested card stacks.
Botanical first-party icons instead of platform emoji.
Responsive phone and tablet composition, never a stretched phone mockup.

rules.name: The One Warm Action Rule
rules.body: Persimmon should occupy less than roughly ten percent of a screen. Its rarity makes the next action obvious.

rules.name: The State Before Decoration Rule
rules.body: Sage means completion or growth, gold means tiny or warm emphasis, and danger red means destructive action. Never use these roles interchangeably.

rules.name: The Editorial Split Rule
rules.body: Serif type expresses place and meaning. Sans type expresses action and state.

rules.name: The Flat Agenda Rule
rules.body: Habit rows, task rows, history rows, and settings rows use dividers, not individual shadows.

dos: Do let the approved watercolor garden carry atmosphere while every interactive control remains real HTML with visible states.
Do preserve 44px touch targets, three-pixel keyboard focus, readable state labels, reduced motion, and 200 percent zoom.
Do compose tablets as a deliberate two-page spread when space allows.
donts: Don't build an emoji collage interface where platform glyphs substitute for a designed asset system.
Don't use neon gamer dashboards, heavy RPG terminology, multiple currencies, punishment, or loss mechanics.
Don't make a corporate productivity dashboard that turns self-care into performance management.
Don't create a childish toy interface that reduces readability, dignity, or all-ages appeal.
Don't ship generic AI-generated pastel cards, decorative glass effects, or inconsistent controls.
Don't use streak systems that shame users, reset their identity to zero, or make rest feel like failure.
